events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Detroit Tigers

notes.headline: Game called (rain) with 1 out in the top of the 9th

headlines.description: — Kerry Carpenter, Zach McKinstry and Matt Vierling hit two-run homers and drove in three runs apiece, and the Detroit Tigers powered their way to an 11-6, rain-shortened victory over the St. Louis Cardinals on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tigers' offense erupts with four home runs in 11-6 victory over the Cardinals

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Garrett Mitchell matched a career high for RBI with a two-run double and a three-run homer in the first three innings alone, and the Milwaukee Brewers held on to beat the Kansas City Royals 5-2 on Saturday in the opener of their doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell provides all the Brewers offense in 5-2 win over Royals to open their split doubleheader

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Munetaka Murakami hit a two-run homer and Colson Montgomery followed with a solo shot in Chicago’s three-run sixth inning as the White Sox beat the Toronto Blue Jays 6-3 Saturday for their second straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murakami and Montgomery homers help power White Sox to a 6-3 win over the Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Nick Yorke singled home Bryan Reynolds in the bottom of the ninth inning to lift the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 3-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Yorke's walk-off single lifts the Pittsburgh Pirates past the Baltimore Orioles 3-2

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Washington Nationals

leaders.displayValue: 1-2, HR, 2 RBI, 2 R, 2 BB, SB, K
1-2, HR, 2 RBI, 2 R, 2 BB, SB, K

headlines.description: — Freddie Freeman hit two-run doubles in the first and second innings and Andy Pages added a three-run homer in the fifth to help the Los Angeles Dodgers to a 10-5 rout of the Washington Nationals on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman, Pages lead another offensive barrage by the Dodgers in a 10-5 win over Washington

headlines.description: — Christian Walker homered, doubled and drove in two runs as the Houston Astros routed the Athletics 11-0 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker homers, Peña gets 600th hit as Astros rout Athletics 11-0

events.name: San Diego Padres at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Ramón Laureano had a bloop RBI single with two outs in the ninth inning off closer Aroldis Chapman and the San Diego Padres outlasted the Boston Red Sox 3-2 on Saturday at frigid Fenway Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Padres beat Red Sox 3-2 at frigid Fenway on Laureano's bloop RBI single in 9th

events.name: Miami Marlins at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Giancarlo Stanton stole his first base in the regular season since 2020 and had a go-ahead, two-run single to help the New York Yankees beat the Miami Marlins 9-7 on Saturday night for their first 7-1 start in seven seasons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stanton has first steal since 2020, hits 2-run single in Yankees' 9-7 win over Marlins

headlines.description: — Rhett Lowder allowed three hits over six innings as the Cincinnati Reds beat the Texas Rangers 2-0 on Saturday night, giving the right-hander his first win since 2024 after missing all of last season because of injuries.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reds blank Rangers 2-0 as Lowder pitches scoreless innings in first win since 2024

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Jonathan Aranda hit a two-run double, Yandy Díaz drove in two runs and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Minnesota Twins 7-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aranda, Díaz and Matz lead the Rays to a 7-1 victory over the Twins

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Salvador Perez’s solo homer highlighted a six-run sixth inning as the Kansas City Royals beat the Milwaukee Brewers 8-2 to earn a doubleheader split Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Perez’s homer highlights 6-run 6th inning as Royals top Brewers 8-2 for doubleheader split

headlines.description: — Rookie José Fernandez's bunt single in the second inning led to two unearned runs and the Arizona Diamondbacks held on to defeat the Atlanta Braves 2-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks score twice on bunt and throwing error, hold off Braves 2-1

headlines.description: — Trea Turner hit a go-ahead RBI double in the fifth inning and the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Colorado Rockies 2-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luzardo fans 11, Turner hits go-ahead RBI double as Phillies edge Rockies 2-1

events.name: New York Mets at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Clay Holmes and Tobias Myers combined on a three-hitter and the New York Mets beat the San Francisco Giants 9-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Holmes, Myers limit Giants to 3 hits in Mets' 9-0 romp

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Jo Adell made three home run-robbing catches, including a spectacular leaping grab while crashing into the seats...
headlines.shortLinkText: Neto homers and Adell robs the Mariners of 3 home runs in the Angels' 1-0 victory
